premises.text: Analysts spend a significant amount of time searching for market research data
premises.evidence_span: the average analyst spends 19 percent of their day researching

premises.text: The current methods of finding market research data are outdated and inefficient
premises.evidence_span: the last major innovation in how we look for this type of data was Google 20 years ago

premises.text: T4 can quickly find comprehensive industry data for analysts
premises.evidence_span: T4, a web platform lets analysts quickly find comprehensive industry data

premises.text: UICS provides a more granular classification of industries than existing standards
premises.evidence_span: UICS is T4's unified industry classification system, a method of classifying industries that is 10 times more granular than NAICS

premises.text: TOM ensures comprehensive indexing of market research data
premises.evidence_span: TOM ensures that we aggregate a complete set of market research within each industry and index the quantitative data within each report

premises.text: T4 significantly reduces the time analysts spend searching for data
premises.evidence_span: What normally takes hours, Sarah just did in 30 seconds

premises.text: T4 is accessible to various types of analysts through a SaaS license
premises.evidence_span: We have investors, strategy, sales and marketing analysts who can access T4 through a SaaS license

premises.text: The market opportunity for T4 is substantial, starting with tech sector analysts
premises.evidence_span: Initially, we're targeting the 3.5 million tech sector analysts, representing a $7 billion global market opportunity

value.text: Analysts can save significant time and improve efficiency in their research process
value.evidence_span: save hours of research every single day

notes: Corporate customer count, fundraising, and demo offers are excluded as traction.
